decisions.statement: A reader who is not signed in imports nothing.
A hash the codec will not decode is refused rather than part-imported.
A hash the reader already has gives back the build already filed.
A companion build is always live.
The build name is the companion and the main-hand weapon.
A companion with no readable main-hand weapon is named by the companion.

definition: a companion build decoded from a hash and filed against the reader's account
